Haha!  6.5 and I barely made my game, 95% Claude code and all AI art.

replies.author: AutomaticTalent
replies.body:
The initial concept in 1991 was a board game with no edges (Risk), and no edge strategies, but simple territory capture like GO.

Then any graphics and audio can be used with the same mechanics. It’s currently country vs. country but I have a few more AudioGraphics sets in the wings. 

I prototyped it on a beach ball.

This version is Wetware (your brain) vs. Software (AI). 

I’m testing PvP now for an imminent release.

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body:
what score did you give yourself on game design again?

for a sense of whether any given game mechanic is good, you can abuse the algorithm tf-idf

1. identify a collection of games using this mechanic
2. count how many of these games are liked
3. in the larger bin of games of that style, count how many games are liked
4. observe a ratio of over 1/1 as a positive sign, and below 1/1 as a negative sign

if 1 is small, that's also warning sign.  by example, you can note that jump scares in games almost don't exist outside horror.
